arms.label: S3 alone: first mover limited to 1 action on turn 1

design.seeds: one fresh common list for all three arms (matched seeds, both first movers per seed), chosen and committed at approval time; not 64001-64030 (V4 pilot) and not the V4 holdout 65001-65060
design.planner: decided at approval: production planner (comparable to V3), or the EV candidate if the operator adopts it first. Fixed for all arms.

comparisons.tests: KX3-N1 predictions: first_mover_win_rate decrease >= 0.15; turn1_score_rate decrease >= 0.10
KX3-N2 predictions (only if N2 is registered): conveyor_per_game decrease >= 5; abs_first_mover_edge decrease >= 0.10

KX3-N3 discriminating design: which single factor lowers the first-mover rate more, judged by its own words: a drop of at least 15 points without a comparable rise in turn-limit games (operationalised as turn_limit_rate increase < 0.10)

design.uncertainty: paired-by-seed bootstrap 95% intervals (V3 pairedDiff), the frozen V3 met / contradicted / unclear rule
design.acceptance: Neither arm is a correction until it also clears the V3 acceptance gates (server/balance/v3/proposals.ts acceptCorrection) on an untouched holdout.
